nodes.label: ToF facade + dual backend compiled via #if, not CMake selection
nodes.rationale: Both VL53L0X and VL53L1X backends are always in SRCS; each file self-#ifs on BOARD_TOF_CHIP so only one emits code and the other compiles to an empty object. File selection was NOT done in CMake because CMake only reads configuration at configure time and PlatformIO does not re-run configure when only a header changes — so switching chips and rebuilding would silently produce the OLD firmware (the same trap documented at the top of include/flight_core/fc_features.h). Going through #if makes the compiler emit a depfile and forces ninja to recompile.

nodes.label: flight_core REQUIRES esp_driver_i2c (new I2C master API)
nodes.rationale: Changed from the umbrella `driver` component (only needed for legacy i2c.h, EOL in ESP-IDF v6.0 and removed in v7.0) to `esp_driver_i2c`, which carries i2c_master.h. ESP-IDF 6.x also split driver/ledc.h and driver/gpio.h into esp_driver_ledc / esp_driver_gpio, both added here alongside esp_adc for battery_driver.

nodes.label: flight_core as standalone ESP-IDF component
nodes.rationale: Builds and verifies independently of main/ and micropython_module/ — it includes nothing from either, which is what makes the two-tier boundary enforceable at build time rather than by convention.
